summary.text: George Lang is serving his second term in the Ohio Senate for District 4, which covers the majority of Butler County, and was elected by his Senate colleagues as Senate Majority Whip for the 136th General Assembly. He previously served two terms in the Ohio House.

paragraphs.text: Lang graduated from Southeast Missouri State University in 1985 with a major in Communications and a double minor in Marketing and Speech.

After eight years in sales and managerial positions at Procter & Gamble, he left to start his own business in the financial services industry, and more than 100 people are now employed by businesses he helped to create.

Since moving to West Chester in 1990, Lang served seven years on the West Chester Board of Zoning Appeals, then won election as township trustee in 2003 and served until he was appointed to the House in 2017.
In 2018, he and several Senate and House colleagues created the Business First Caucus, which the Senate page describes as the largest bipartisan, bicameral legislative caucus.

Lang is Vice Chair of the Financial Institutions, Insurance and Technology Committee and also sits on the Energy, Finance, Rules and Reference, Small Business and Economic Opportunity, and Workforce Development committees.
He and his high school sweetheart, Debbie, have been married for 40 years, have two daughters, and live in West Chester.
